answer.content: No source provides quantified token reduction rates or their correlation with state drift as required. While S2 observes persistent errors indicating state drift, it lacks token-level metrics. The requested data from Kumar et al., 2024, Section 4.1 is missing from the evidence set, rendering the research ungrounded. A bounded revision is necessary to restrict analysis to only those sources that explicitly report token usage and retention trends under periodic input and known perturbations. Without such data, no causal or quantitative inference can be drawn from observed behavior alone.
